identificationModule.briefTitle: Study Comparing Arzoxifene With Raloxifene in Women After Menopause With Osteoporosis
identificationModule.officialTitle: The Comparison of the Efficacy and Safety of Arzoxifene Versus Raloxifene in Postmenopausal Women With Osteoporosis

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to compare the effect of arzoxifene to raloxifene on the bone mineral density (bone strength).

interventions.name: Arzoxifene
interventions.description: 20 mg, oral, tablet, once a day for 52 weeks

interventions.name: Raloxifene
interventions.description: 60 mg, oral, tablet, once a day for 52 weeks

primaryOutcomes.measure: Percent change in Lumbar Spine BMD

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Secondary BMD measures of total hip and femoral neck
Biochemical markers of bone metabolism assessed

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Must have osteoporosis
* Must be between 50 and 75 years old and be able to walk
* Have at least two of your back bones that can be x-rayed
* Have not had a period in at least two years
* Be willing to have blood tests

Exclusion Criteria:

* Have a bone disease other than osteoporosis
* History of estrogen dependent cancer
* History of stroke or certain heart problems
* Possibly have an allergy to raloxifene or arzoxifene
* Have certain abnormal lab values
* History of seizure disorder
* Have unexplained vaginal bleeding or an abnormal pap smear
